show: Mariana Cabaret, the Spanish musical at Espacio Alma in Madrid (Oct-Dec 2026, 80 minutes). Write the synopsis strictly from this official plot text published by the venue, adding nothing that is not in it: "Madrid, año 2032. Un golpe de Estado ha convertido el país en una sociedad dominada por la represión, donde la libertad parece haber quedado en el pasado. En medio de este escenario, Mariana, una joven artista de cabaret, se enamora de 'El Capitán', líder de un movimiento clandestino que lucha contra la dictadura, y acaba involucrándose en la resistencia. Cuando el Comodoro, máxima autoridad de la ciudad y obsesionado con Mariana, descubre el complot, la somete a un cruel chantaje: deberá elegir entre traicionar a los rebeldes y sus propios ideales o enfrentarse a las consecuencias. Abandonada finalmente por aquellos por quienes arriesgó todo, Mariana tendrá que afrontar sola su destino. Inspirado en la figura de Mariana Pineda y en el universo poético de Federico Garcia Lorca, Mariana Cabaret combina musica en directo, interpretacion, danza y la estetica del cabaret en una historia de amor, resistencia y libertad."
synopsis:
Mariana performs as a cabaret artist in Madrid in 2032, where a coup d’état has remade the country into a society ruled by repression and where freedom seems to belong to the past. Amid this bleak reality, she falls in love with El Capitán, the leader of a clandestine movement resisting the dictatorship. Drawn into both his cause and the underground struggle, Mariana commits herself to the rebels’ fight against the regime.

Her involvement places her directly in the path of the Comodoro, the city’s highest authority. Obsessed with Mariana, he discovers the conspiracy and uses his power to subject her to a cruel blackmail. She is forced into an impossible choice: betray the rebels and abandon her own ideals, or face the consequences of refusing him. The threat turns her private feelings, political commitment, and personal freedom into the stakes of a single decision.

Having risked everything for the resistance, Mariana ultimately finds herself abandoned by those for whom she has sacrificed so much. With the support she expected gone, she must confront her fate alone in a city where repression holds power and the struggle for freedom carries a devastating cost.

At its heart, the story brings love into conflict with dictatorship, resistance, and betrayal. It asks what remains of a person’s ideals when freedom is threatened and loyalty fails.

show: ¡Es Navidad!, the family Christmas musical by Dalpao Producciones at Teatro Salesianos Estrecho in Madrid (Dec 2026 - Jan 2027, 70 minutes). Write the synopsis strictly from this official plot text, adding nothing that is not in it: "¿Y si la Navidad no fuera una fecha... sino un lugar al que siempre podemos volver? Cuando el espiritu navideño comienza a desaparecer, un viaje inesperado de dos duendes llevara a pequeños y mayores fuera del polo norte a buscar al proximo sustituto de Santa. Alli deben descubrir si los sueños aun brillan, si la ilusion nunca se pierde y si cada sonrisa tiene el poder de hacer realidad los milagros. Deben encontrar un tesoro antes de Nochebuena. Entre personajes inolvidables, canciones emocionantes, grandes coreografias y una historia magica, ¡Es Navidad! invita a toda la familia a vivir una aventura llena de humor, emocion y fantasia, recordandonos que el mejor regalo no se encuentra bajo un arbol, sino en el corazon de quienes compartimos esta epoca tan especial."
synopsis:
Two duendes set out from the Polo Norte as the espíritu navideño begins to fade, embarking on an unexpected journey beyond their snowy home. Their mission is urgent: before Nochebuena arrives, they must find the próximo sustituto de Santa and recover a treasure whose discovery may help preserve the magic of Christmas. As they travel, the duendes are joined by unforgettable characters and confronted with questions that reach far beyond their search. Do dreams still shine? Can ilusión truly disappear, or does it remain waiting to be found again? And might every smile hold the power to make miracles real?

Their adventure unfolds through songs, large-scale choreography, humour, emotion and fantasy, inviting both children and adults into a world where Christmas is more than a date on the calendar. With time running short, the duendes must look for what remains when festive spirit seems to be slipping away, while learning whether the wonder they seek can still be awakened in the hearts around them. Each step brings them closer to the treasure they need to find before Nochebuena—and to the possibility that Navidad may be a place to which everyone can always return.

At its heart, the musical celebrates dreams, ilusión and the capacity for smiles to create miracles. It also reminds audiences that the finest gift is not found beneath a árbol, but in the hearts of the people with whom this special season is shared.

show: Leyendas Mexicanas de Terror 2, the Day of the Dead musical by Tort Producciones at Teatro Telon de Asfalto in Mexico City (Oct-Nov 2026, 100 minutes). Write the synopsis strictly from this official plot text, adding nothing that is not in it and naming no legend that does not appear in it: "Espectaculo de terror narrado por catrinas y catrines aderezado con canciones populares del dia de muertos. Historias como La Llorona, La Planchada, o La Tamalera asesina, forman parte de los testimonios populares incluidos en Leyendas Mexicanas de Terror, una obra para todos los amantes de los musicales y las narraciones de espantos." Cast: Ady Salazar, Tony Batres, Fanny Vega and David Tort.
synopsis:
Beneath the watchful gaze of catrinas and catrines, the dead begin to speak. Their tales emerge through a spectacle of terror shaped by popular Day of the Dead songs, turning the stage into a space where music accompanies testimony and fright walks beside remembrance. Voices rise from the world of Mexican legends, carrying stories that have endured in popular imagination and inviting the audience into a night of espantos.

La Llorona is among the figures summoned by these narrations, her presence joining a procession of feared and remembered apparitions. La Planchada also enters the collection of testimonies, while La Tamalera asesina brings another dark tale into the gathering. Each legend becomes part of a shared encounter with the supernatural, presented through the ceremonial imagery of the Día de Muertos and the musical force of its familiar songs.

As the catrinas and catrines guide the evening, terror is not held apart from celebration. The dead are given voices, popular stories are carried into performance, and frightening accounts unfold amid the sounds associated with a holiday devoted to honoring those who have passed on. The result is a sequence of ghostly narratives in which the eerie, the festive, and the musical coexist.

The show brings together fear, memory, and popular tradition through Day of the Dead music and tales of espantos. It treats the supernatural as both a source of terror and a living part of collective remembrance.
